senses.gloss: (denom. of next w.) to divide by nine.—Part. pass. מְתוּשָּׁע; pl. מְתוּשָּׁעִים.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 1:3:3">Y. Shebi. I, 33ᵇ</cite> <he>ובלבד שלא יפחות מחשבון מת׳</he> provided that there be no less than the quantity (of one Kikkar) divided by nine, i.e. that none of the nine trees yield less than one-ninth of a Kikkar.
